name: comp-444

frames.best_why: Packages tab is selected with its matching panel text and the cursor is clear of the control.

tagline: Three icon-labelled tabs switch a small panel of text beside them.
summary: A vertical tab list beside a content pane. Picking Overview, Projects or Packages moves the highlight and swaps the text shown in the panel.
appearance: A small vertical list of three tabs, Overview, Projects and Packages, each with a thin line icon, sits at the top left of a dark stage. A slim bordered panel beside it holds one grey line of text, and the active tab carries a short accent bar on its left edge.
behaviour: Clicking a tab moves the accent bar to that row and swaps the panel text for the matching section. Rows pick up a faint filled background under the cursor.
demo_content: Tab labels Overview, Projects and Packages, with placeholder text "Content for Tab 1" to "Content for Tab 3".
search_phrases: switch between panels with a tab list
tabs for overview projects and packages
use_when: A few peer sections share one pane and a vertical list uses the space better than a top tab bar.
avoid_when: The panels are empty placeholders, so you must build the real content for each tab yourself.
customise: Tab labels, their icons and the placeholder panel text are written in the file, so changing sections means editing the source; no props are exposed.
weight_why: Three short tab rows and a one-line panel; switching is an instant DOM swap.

a11y.note: Icons are hidden from screen readers and each tab is labelled by text; panel changes are not announced as a live region.

issues: Not icon-only as described: every tab also shows a text label.
Panel is an almost empty strip, so most of the demo stage is blank.
polish_why: Clean active bar and hover state, but the nearly empty pane makes it read unfinished.
title: Vertical Icon Sidebar Tabs
